attributes.action: Don't ban social media for under 16s.
attributes.additional_details: Dont ban it. Rather than eliminating it  as a whole, instead add restrictions that the people being affected by it agree with.
attributes.background: Dont ban social media for under 16s. Instead place restrictions to make it enjoyable and safe without eliminating both the positives and the negatives of social media.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: 

Do not ban social media for under 16s
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/757233
